note: Game trails (Dave 2026-10-21, Mandy's request): animals wear paths in the grass. The server keeps a coarse grid (cell_m metres a side, kept sparse: only worn cells exist) and every animal that steps into a new cell adds pass_add x its species weight, up to max_strength. Strength drops decay_per_game_day each game day (the clock runs 24:1, so 0.25 a game day is about 1 real hour per quarter strength: a lightly worn cell clears in a few real hours, a well-used path in about four). Blocks of block_cells x block_cells cells (256 m at 4 m) are sent compressed to each player for the 3 x 3 blocks around them when they enter a block and when a block changes, at most every resend_s per block. The client draws cells at or above draw_threshold as lower grass and a paler tint (Mandy). Saved in trails.json in the server store (not a tile file). All numbers here are tunables.
